The '''Ralltiiri Light Freighter''' was a class of [[light freighter]] active during the [[First Order-Resistance War]]. At least one Ralltiiri Light [[Freighter]] participated in the [[Battle of Exegol]] against the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]] as part of the [[Citizens' Fleet]].<ref name="Kids" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TRXCaseStudyv2-19.jpg|thumb|right|The Ralltiiri Light Freighter was one of the many new ship models created by ILM for ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker''.]]
The Ralltiiri Light Freighter appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> The vehicle was first identified in the [[2020]] video "Every Ship in the Star Wars Sequel Trilogy" which was released as part of the ''[[Star Wars By the Numbers]]'' series on the [[StarWarsKids.com]] [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] channel.<ref name="Kids" />
